promptTemplate: Use case: illustration-story. Soulbeast mobile fantasy RPG asset, painterly detailed premium dark fantasy with gold/teal lighting. Create ONE atlas image divided into exactly THREE equal horizontal panels stacked vertically, no gaps, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI frames. Each panel is a wide landscape illustration. Top panel: main situation. Middle panel: first choice action. Bottom panel: second choice action. Clear readable subjects at small size. Consistent adventurer and world across panels. Scene: {scene}. Rewards modest, no legendary aura. Keep critical subjects centered in each panel. This atlas will be cropped in CSS into three scene buttons.
scenes: sunlit beginner woodland, young adventurer finds a small injured ordinary woodland spirit beside a broken cart; choices: gently bandage and befriend the creature; repair cart and accept a modest coin pouch

silver moonlit forest with hundreds of luminous fireflies gathering around a fallen lantern; choices: follow fireflies and observe their dance for experience; gather spilled coins and a plain equipment bundle by the lantern
misty Chinese mountain forest, tea stall on an old stone bridge, friendly wandering herbalist; choices: solve a tea leaf riddle and gain insight; carry a herb basket and receive a modest coin pouch
golden desert ruins, exhausted ordinary sand creature beneath a torn caravan awning; choices: share water and befriend sand creature; help unload caravan and accept plain equipment
high windy mountain, a broken wind chime bridge guarded by a friendly mountain traveler; choices: balance across stepping stones and learn; repair bridge ropes and receive a plain weapon
fallen celestial garden, scattered star fragments beside a cracked fountain; choices: return fragments and receive ordinary winged creature; sort star fragments for coins and insight

dark fantasy demon castle service corridor, small friendly lost demon courier with spilled parcels; choices: guide courier to safe stairs for coins and experience; help repack parcels and receive ordinary equipment
